method.description: Individually inspected chronological overview sheet of 12 evenly spaced frames plus denser sheets sampling every fourth frame and final frame. Compared against previously visually inspected exact-hash source. Metadata verified with ffprobe. No realtime playback claimed.

observations: Mother kangaroo and joey remain coherent with long ears, pouch, hind legs and tail; turquoise scarf, purple hat and red/yellow ball retain their source colors and identities.
Mother gently bobs and tilts her head while the tail lifts and settles; joey leans and peeks slightly farther from the pouch. A brief blink/wink is visible in later samples.
Movement is restrained but visibly changes pose, rather than being only a camera zoom or frozen picture. Pouch and joey overlap stays understandable, and ball/grass remain stable.
No duplicate limbs, detached heads, prop disappearance or obvious anatomy morphing appears in inspected frames.
limitations: Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of every inter-sample artifact or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
